label: Mid-sequence original-phase steps right after an "f" input
explanation: Fires only during the original (input) phase at positions t=3..8, peaking at t=5-6; never in the copy phase and almost never on <DEL>. The strongest driver is the previous input being the letter f: at t=4..6 with prev_tok==f it is active 98% of the time and this covers most top-quartile activations (top examples are all the 1-2 steps after an f at position 3-4). Activation decays one step later (prev2_tok==f gives moderate values). The current token identity hardly matters. A long tail of weak activations (bottom two quartiles) fires at t=4..6 on arbitrary tokens without a recent f (weakly elevated after 0, s, z), which the predicate misses; it does not fire at t<3 even after f, and f at t=3 (prev_tok f at step 3) is often inactive.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: t=3 & prev_tok=f (+7.20), prev_tok=f (+6.50), prev2_tok=f (+5.61), t=4 & prev_tok=f (+5.30), t=5 & prev_tok=f (+3.64), orig1=v (+2.94). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-9.46), orig_idx=-1 (-8.50), prev_tok=2 (-6.91), t=3 (-6.17).
